title: TF_REPEATED_DATA and TF_OLD_DATA in ROS 2: duplicate timestamps, data from the past, sim time jumps and Authority undetectable, measured
excerpt: ROS 2 Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical never printed TF_REPEATED_DATA: duplicate stamps were silently overwritten. TF_OLD_DATA appeared past the 10 s cache, once per dropped message. After a /clock jump a plain Python Buffer stayed stuck; Buffer(node=node) cleared on Jazzy and Lyrical.
